TRUNK_LEAN.text: Focus on keeping your trunk upright during the movement.

SHOULDER_HIKE.text: Try to keep your shoulder relaxed and down during the exercise.

TOO_FAST.text: Slow down and control each movement — quality matters more than speed.

ROM_INCOMPLETE_FLEX.text: Try to bend your elbow a little further to get the full range of motion.

ROM_INCOMPLETE_EXTEND.text: Try to straighten your arm fully at the end of each repetition.

ASYMMETRY.text: Try to keep both sides moving equally and smoothly.

SHOULDER_ELEVATION.text: Keep your shoulder blade stable and avoid shrugging during the movement.
